metadata.description: Sanctuum's skill set for Claude Code — a stack-agnostic core plus Symfony, Python, and C# tracks.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Orchestration core, flagship workflows, standards & design skills, communication, and meta — stack-agnostic. Install at user scope; always on.

plugins.name: symfony-stack
plugins.description: Symfony 7.x / PHP 8.3+ skills: symfony, doctrine, symfony-upgrade, php-upgrade, composer. Install at local scope in Symfony repos.

plugins.name: python-stack
plugins.description: Python skills for async, real-time, multi-process services: conventions, asyncio, Unix-socket IPC, process supervision, chunked streaming, audio DSP, local model inference, LLM interaction, multi-step decision processes. Install at local scope in Python repos.

plugins.name: csharp-stack
plugins.description: C#/.NET skills for NetCord-based Discord bots, incl. Unix-socket IPC with a length-prefixed binary protocol. Install at local scope in C# repos.
